## Key Facts
- Jumeirah Residences Al Maryah Island: branded apartments and penthouses on Al Maryah Island, developed by Aldar Properties in partnership with Jumeirah Group, from approximately AED 3,000,000.
- Al Maryah Island: Abu Dhabi's financial free zone (ADGM), home to The Galleria, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, and a cluster of five-star hospitality brands.
- UAE Golden Visa: a property purchase of AED 2,000,000 or more in a designated freehold zone (Al Maryah Island qualifies) grants a 10-year renewable residency visa to the buyer and immediate family.
- Foreign nationals can hold 100% freehold ownership in Abu Dhabi's designated investment zones, with no local sponsor required.
